review_comments: About the question on Discord, I think some code is removing `Number.raw` .
You can see a list of codes touching `Number.raw` by using vscode feature.

As [the playground link](https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.6.7&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0vOzysuUahQsFXQNUy1tLS0BgAenTgBEQAAAA%3D%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA21QOw7CMAzde4rKMwPqwMAdmDiBFVwU1HxkOxJV1buTtA0tEksUv4%2Bf7alpW3iJgWs75W8uIrIQf%2BuMyOgV3xkBHSOJYRsVTpVVKVSPg9ACzSsDivwkLS6S7tx1mwOGEISqY8Oc9bYfj5kmuMgk8issUvTPgf4nMnrpA7tjIyY0egAyZF0MrPeQ2JRG4KO7rrLTLuLk1bqFx6TBoVoDGz039V2iwYVHWmbaTljOtC5%2BgV1Ud%2FzuA1Zu1amcqJk%2FtsEHsI4BAAA%3D) uses `ES2022` as the target and does not enable optimization, you need to check for 

 - swc_ecma_transforms_typescript
 - swc_ecma_transforms_proposal
 - swc_ecma_transforms_base (unlikely, but well)
Isn't this logic duplicate of the logic above?

`if` part is same but else part isn't. And I can't move the if part above this match as this part is only needed for first branch of the match and not for others and they don't use `.value` directly instead performs operations to `raw`
